description: compute_merged_modules reconciliation: find the intra-group references a split makes cross before/common/after from the common and after parts only (their references and referrers), reading where the other end is from its occurrences, now keyed (chunk group, list) -> entry, or its settled position once popped; a reference out of common is one occurrence-set intersection per split, and already exposed modules are skipped. No hash sets of the whole before/common/after lists per occurrence; the lists and the exposed set are the same
